title: Missing Signals
summary: Work with NA: count missing values and use na.rm = TRUE to summarise what's left.
hints: `mean(sleep_hours)` gives NA because one unknown value makes the mean unknown.
`sum(is.na(sleep_hours))` counts the missing values; `sum(!is.na(sleep_hours))` counts the valid ones (`!` means *not*).
Add `na.rm = TRUE` to drop missing values before averaging: `mean(sleep_hours, na.rm = TRUE)`.
